method: Opus readers (print + WG raw ops + every carrier) each followed by an adversarial verifier; findings applied by 8 family spec(s), verdicts derived by scripts/wg-batch-close.mjs from the cited rows, edits, tests and teaches

confirmed.summary: The digest's "spell | conditional | NO-SHEET-EFFECT" flags are a comparer misread: the conscious mind's granted spells, psi cantrips and its level ladder are all delivered, and the record does have a sheet effect.
The Distant Grasp increases telekinetic projectile's range to 60 feet and neither side models it, so the spell row shows the unmodified 30 feet.
The Distant Grasp raises telekinetic hand's carrying capacity on a rank ladder and neither side models it, so the spell row shows only the base light-Bulk limit.

The SET-GAP flags (resistances theirs=piercing,slashing ours=(nothing); weaknesses theirs=fire ours=(nothing)) are a comparer misread — we carry exactly those three entries, on `whileActive`, with the same 3+Con value WG uses.

Wooden Rage's additional damage is delivered twice — once correctly and level-scaled by the Rage strike rider, and again by the `cat-wooden-rage` mode's own +6 damage modifier, which is frozen at 6 and so contradicts the printed 10/18 escal

The MISSING skill|acrobatics flag is an instrument misread: the Way Skill is granted by the gunslinger's own subclass option, not by the class-feature record.
The `grants theirs-not-ours=[intothefray, finishthejob, drifterswake]` flag is an instrument misread: all three deeds are granted at the right levels through the subclass option's featureIds.
The MISSING skill|medicine, skill|occultism and the `spellcasting` flag are instrument misreads: both skills and the occult casting source are carried by the summoner subclass option.
WG asks the player to choose the eidolon's language and we ask nothing and record nothing — the printed Language line reaches the player only as inert description text.
The MISSING skill|diplomacy flag is an instrument misread: Diplomacy is granted by the investigator subclass option, and the No Cause for Alarm feat grant is already carried too.

The MISSING skill|occultism flag and `spells theirs-not-ours=[nudgefate, surestrike]` are instrument misreads: the patron skill, the occult spell list and both spells are carried by the witch subclass option.

All three flags on Flame Order (skill|acrobatics MISSING, grants theirs-not-ours=[firelung], spells theirs-not-ours=[wildfire]) are an instrument misread: every one of them is carried on the druid class record's subclass option, which the c

The NO-SHEET-EFFECT flag on The Tangible Dream is wrong: the conscious mind's 14 granted spells and their level ladder are both built and both reach the sheet, on the psychic class record rather than on the feature record.

The Conscious Mind picker's description for The Tangible Dream shows an empty "2nd:" line — the 2nd-rank granted spell Invisibility was dropped from the subclass-option copy of the text, so a player choosing a conscious mind reads that this

The four MISSING lore-proficiency flags and the ten theirs-not-ours spells on Speaker in Sibilance are an instrument misread: the Lores (with their 8th/16th ladder), all ten apparition spells and the vessel focus spell are carried on the an

The theirs-not-ours=[fortifysummoning, spiralofhorrors] flag on School of the Boundary is an instrument misread: both school spells are carried on the wizard class record's subclass option, and we additionally model the full curriculum that
The baseline digest's "MISSING skill|occultism" is a comparer misread: Occultism trained IS delivered, on the witch's subclass OPTION rather than on the classFeatures record.
The digest's "MISSING skill|deception" and "MISSING skill|nature" are comparer misreads: both are delivered by the summoner subclass option.

Print grants the eidolon the Magical Understudy feat at 1st and Magical Adept at 7th; we grant neither, so a fey summoner's eidolon never gets its two innate cantrips even though the plumbing to hold them already exists.
Fey Gift Spells widens the summoner's repertoire to arcane illusion/mental spells; neither side models it, so the one thing the fey eidolon exists for is unavailable in the spell picker.
Print gives the fey eidolon Sylvan; WG grants a language for it and we model no eidolon language anywhere.
Neither side models the Overdrive rider: the resistance stays at 3 + half level while overdriven, where print says it rises by 2.
The digest's "MISSING skill|crafting" is a comparer misread: Crafting trained is delivered by the investigator subclass option.
An Alchemical Sciences investigator gets no versatile vial counter, so the Quick Tincture action we grant them has nothing to spend — neither side models the vials.

The record carries the LEGACY Advanced Player's Guide aonId and edition:'legacy' while its text and source are the current Player Core 2 methodology, so the four current investigator methodologies are treated as legacy content by the editio
The digest's "MISSING skill|nature" and "MISSING skill|survival" are comparer misreads: both are delivered by the summoner subclass option.

Our eidolon note applies the FIRE core's resistance/weakness/+1 damage to every element, which print gives to fire alone — five of the six cores are shown a benefit they do not have and are missing the one they do.
The Elemental Core pick has NO READER: the player chooses air/earth/fire/metal/wood/water and nothing in src/ ever consults the answer.
The innovation IS a light mortar the character owns from 1st level, and nothing in our data hands it over — WG gives the item, we grant no item and no siege companion.
The initial light mortar modification is asked twice — once by the record's own inert `choice`, once by the live inventor modification picker that actually applies the pick.

The innovation's own scaling statistics (AC/DC from your class DC, Int-based HP and saves, hardness and save-rank steps, extra damage die every 4 levels) are modelled by neither side, so the shipped light mortar stays a fixed level-1 siege

The 'spells theirs-not-ours=[handoftheapprentice, interdisciplinaryincantation]' flag is a comparer misread — both school spells are carried, just on the wizard subclass option rather than on the classFeatures record.

A UMT wizard's Drain Bonded Item still shows one use per day at every level; print gives one use per day per spell rank they can cast, and no carrier in the app can retune a class feature's limitedUses from a subclass option.

The 'skill|religion theirs=trained ours=(nothing)' and 'spells theirs-not-ours=[stoketheheart, command]' flags are a comparer misread — the tradition, the patron skill and both spells are all carried on the witch subclass option.

The 'skill|religion theirs=trained ours=(nothing)' and 'spells theirs-not-ours=[tradedeathforlife, sleep]' flags are a comparer misread — the tradition, the patron skill and both spells are all carried on the witch subclass option.
The 'SET-GAP set|resistances … ours=(nothing)' flag is a comparer misread — Raging Resistance is carried as a whileActive clause with the same rage gate and the same 3+Con value WG uses.
Rotting Rage's damage never grows: our mode adds a flat +6 at every level, where print (and WG) give 10 once you have weapon specialization and 18 with greater weapon specialization.
Our cursebound note invents a mechanic the print does not have — it tells the player cursebound 4 kills them, when print gives a -10-foot status penalty to all Speeds.
The cursebound 4 Speed penalty reaches no number on our sheet even though the mode lane can carry it — WG applies -10 status to all five Speeds.

Instrument misread: the comparer reported the Mountain/Volcano Lore ranks as stuck at trained and all ten apparition spells as missing — the level ladder and the spells are on the animist class record's apparition option, not the classFeatu
Two of our carriers train the same two apparition Lores for this record: the class option's grants.lores and a flat entry in featGrantsAuto.ts.
Instrument misread: the comparer reported Crafting training, the Steadying Stone feat and the Crushing Ground order spell as missing — all three are on the druid class record's subclass option.
Instrument misread: MISSING-CONTROL is wrong — the Power Suit / Subterfuge Suit choice is a visible control in the Builder, and it gates the modification picker exactly as WG's select does.

Choosing the suit does not put the innovation armor in the character's inventory — WG's select hands over the Power Suit or Subterfuge Suit item, so our inventor gets no AC bonus, Dex cap, check penalty or Speed penalty from their innovatio

Print (and WG) let the resistance be VITALITY instead of void for a character with void healing; ours hard-codes void with no choice, so a dhampir inventor gets a resistance that never applies and loses the one that does.

Print (and WG) extend the resistance to unholy damage for a holy-sanctified character and to holy damage for an unholy-sanctified one; ours carries no sanctification branch at all, so a sanctified inventor is short a whole resistance.

Our stored text for the apparition's avatar Strike drops the damage TYPE printed on it — "6d10+6 bludgeoning" became "6d10+6" — so the player reading the avatar's melee attack has no damage type at all; the same drop hit 10 of the 14 appari

Two of our own carriers grant this apparition's Ocean/Sailing Lore: the class option's grants.lores (with the correct 8th/16th ladder) and a flat-'trained' row in featGrantsAuto.ts that fires through the same build pass.

The digest's "DIFFERENT skill|lore:ocean theirs=expert/master ours=trained" and "spells theirs-not-ours=[causticblast … implosion]" are instrument misreads: it read classFeatures/lurker-in-devouring-dark plus featGrantsAuto.ts and never loo

The digest's "spells theirs-not-ours=[graspingvine, unsettlingknowledge]" is an instrument misread: both school spells are carried on the wizard subclass option, not on classFeatures/school-of-the-reclamation.

The digest's "spells theirs-not-ours=[debilitatingterror, shroudofthemantis] | ours=[(nothing)]" is an instrument misread: both school spells are carried on the wizard SUBCLASS OPTION, not on the classFeatures record the comparer read.

The description the Builder actually shows for this arcane school has six curriculum spell names silently deleted, so the player reads an incomplete curriculum while the mechanical `curriculum` field is complete.

The digest's "MISSING skill|diplomacy" and "MISSING skill|religion" are instrument misreads: both trained skills are carried on the summoner SUBCLASS OPTION, not on the classFeatures record the comparer read.
Their encoding grants the angel eidolon's language and ours grants no language at all — neither the eidolon stat block nor any character-side lane delivers Celestial/Empyrean for this eidolon type.

Two of our three copies of Hallowed Strikes carry pre-remaster text that contradicts print: one says "good damage" harming "evil creatures", the other states the extra damage unconditionally and drops both the holy trait and the target rest

The flagged gap is an instrument misread: Athletics training and all three deeds ARE delivered, by the Gunslinger subclass table in core.json, not by the classFeatures/way-of-the-vanguard record the comparer read.
The flagged gap is an instrument misread: Stealth training and all three deeds ARE delivered, by the Gunslinger subclass table, not by the classFeatures/way-of-the-sniper record.
The flagged gaps are an instrument misread: Intimidation training and the mushroom patch order spell ARE delivered, by the Druid subclass table.

The MISSING-CONTROL verdict is an instrument misread: the comparer compared their tradition select against our Breath Weapon damage-type picker (two different choices), and the tradition and both skills are already delivered by the Summoner

The dragon eidolon never gains darkvision on the sheet: COMPANION_MODS['dragon-eidolon'] authors it but that table is keyed by the OWNER'S FEAT ids, and the eidolon type is character.subclassId, so the entry has no reader.
The dragon eidolon's printed language (Draconic) is not modelled anywhere — the eidolon block has no language lane at all — while WG delivers it.
Breath Weapon prints two choices and a trait consequence; we record only the damage type, and WG records neither — the area (60-foot line vs 30-foot cone) and the matching damage trait are lost.
The construct eidolon never gains darkvision on the sheet: COMPANION_MODS['construct-eidolon'] authors it but is keyed by owner feat id, and the eidolon type arrives as character.subclassId.
The construct eidolon's printed language pick ('one common mortal language') is not offered anywhere in our app; WG asks for it.

Our Construct Heart situational entry states only part of the printed benefit: the condition text is cut off with an ellipsis (dropping poison, fatigued and sickened) and the DC 10 persistent-bleed flat check is not carried at all.
